requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate AI-driven productivity and manageability solutions for printing and scanning workflows, tailored for SMBs with minimal IT support.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses the need for ease of use and efficiency for SMBs lacking dedicated IT teams; differentiates HP from competitors.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI software integration; depends on consolidated SMB portal.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features are fully integrated and accessible via device and portal; user feedback confirms improved productivity and manageability.

requirements.Title: HP’s Lowest Business Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Deliver a cost-efficient color printing solution with the lowest TCO in HP’s SMB portfolio, including minimized intervention and consumable costs.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs are highly cost-sensitive and seek ROI; this is a core purchase driver.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on tank technology, keyed bottles, and maintenance design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Validated by internal TCO analysis and external benchmarks; published TCO is lower than competitors for target segment.

requirements.Title: Sustainable SMB Tank Printer (60% RCP)
requirements.Description: Design the printer to use at least 60% recycled content plastic (RCP), exceeding competitor benchmarks (Epson 30%).
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a key differentiator and increasingly demanded by customers and regulations.
requirements.Dependencies: Material sourcing and manufacturing process adjustments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product BOM and manufacturing reports confirm 60% RCP; validated by third-party audit if required.

requirements.Title: Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Introduce a customer-replaceable maintenance box to minimize service intervention and downtime.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces maintenance burden for SMBs without IT staff; new feature for this segment.
requirements.Dependencies: Design and supply chain for replaceable parts; service documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can replace maintenance box without service call; instructional material is clear and effective.

requirements.Title: Consolidated SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Develop a unified portal for SMBs to manage multiple printers, access AI solutions, and monitor device status.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs need simple, centralized management due to limited IT resources.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with AI solutions and device firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is accessible, user-friendly, supports management of 6-15 devices, and integrates with AI features.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure ease of use.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces user error and service issues, improving reliability for SMBs.
requirements.Dependencies: Design of bottle and printer interface; supply chain for new bottles.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Field testing shows error rate below 1% for incorrect refilling; positive user feedback.

requirements.Title: Warranty and Serviceability Model
requirements.Description: Provide warranty coverage for 80k pages or 2 years (whichever is first), with customer-replaceable parts (PHA) and service center support (MINK) for out-of-warranty situations.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliability and lowers TCO for SMBs; aligns with business purchase expectations.
requirements.Dependencies: Service documentation, supply of spare parts.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty policy is published; service procedures are documented and operational.

requirements.Title: PDL/PS Support and Speed Improvement
requirements.Description: For PDL SKU, support PDL/PS and achieve print speeds of 25/20 ppm (improved from current 25/19).
requirements.Rationale: Meets advanced SMB requirements for document processing and performance.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware and hardware design; performance testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL/PS support validated; print speeds meet or exceed targets in benchmark tests.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification
requirements.Description: Obtain Blue Angel environmental certification for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Meets regulatory and customer sustainability requirements, especially in specific markets.
requirements.Dependencies: Design and documentation for certification process.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Certification is awarded before product launch in relevant markets.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS (Printing as a Service)
requirements.Description: Ensure printer and portal support integration with HP’s Printing as a Service (PaaS) offerings.
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP’s strategic goal for PaaS acceleration and coverage.
requirements.Dependencies: Portal and firmware development; business model alignment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer and portal are compatible with current and planned PaaS offerings.

requirements.Title: Advanced Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced telemetry for real-time monitoring of device health, usage, and consumables.
requirements.Rationale: Enables proactive support and analytics for SMBs and HP service teams.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is accessible via portal; supports automated alerts and reporting.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing and HP App Integration
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing and printer management via the HP App.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs increasingly rely on mobile devices for business operations.
requirements.Dependencies: HP App compatibility and integration with device firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing and management features are tested and validated with HP App.
